description:
Which applications are installed / enabled on the site — and which are not — in ONE call.
Returns installed[] (id, type, name, enabled) plus not_installed[] (app names). Do NOT call get_app per type
to answer "which apps are on"; use get_app only for one app's settings.
App type codes: 0=product_review, 1=articles_review, 2=automation, 3=telegram, 4=affiliates, 5=multilingual, 6=appointment, 7=send_email, 8=botcake, 9=sale_channel, 10=product_design, 11=auth_otp, 12=personal_product_design, 14=course, 15=zalo_mini_app, 16=cms, 17=recaptcha, 18=pwa.
name: list_apps
